thesis: The podcast discusses the secular trend of capital shifting from active management to passive, low-cost investments like ETFs, particularly within large-cap and large-cap growth U.S. equity styles. The guest identifies three cyclical factors currently hindering active funds: style leadership where indices outperform messy active portfolios, prolonged bull markets which favor passive strategies, and low dispersion between investment styles.
